program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = 9.8; const t = time; const height = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const maxH = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const scaleY = 180 / Math.max(1.28, maxH); const originY = 320; const ballY = originY - height * scaleY; const ballX = 280; const vVal = Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05 ? 0 : velocity; const motionStateVal = vVal > 0.05 ? "Moving up" : vVal < -0.05 ? "Moving down" : "Still for an instant"; const gravityStateVal = "Gravity pulls down"; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 40, w: 560, h: 360, title: "Vertical Toss", state: motionStateVal + " | " + gravityStateVal })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 120, y: 340, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: Math.max(1.5, Math.ceil(maxH * 10) / 10), ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const guideY = originY; objects.push(sdk.line("line.guide", 110, guideY, 400, guideY, { role: "neutral", opacity: 0.5 })); objects.push(sdk.groundMark("mark.launch", 280, originY, 40, "Launch")); if (Math.abs(vVal) >= 0.05) { objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX + 25, y: ballY }, { value: vVal, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); } objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX - 35, y: ballY }, { value: -gravity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 8, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 24, { role: "output" })); let calloutLines = [motionStateVal, "Gravity pulls down"]; objects.push(sdk.callout(ballX + 45, ballY - 20, calloutLines, { id: "callout.toss" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "motionState", value: motionStateVal }, { id: "gravityState", value: gravityStateVal }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, velocity: velocity, height: height, apexTime: launchSpeed / gravity, apexHeight: maxH } }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity pulls it downward.
manifest.description: A simulation of a vertical ball toss showing velocity and gravity vectors, height scale, and dynamic callouts for motion states.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows. Press Play again to watch the ball fall, or drag the timeline to inspect any moment.
